title: viola alba var. besseri
intro: Viola alba var. besseri, commonly known as the White Besseri Violet, is a perennial flowering plant in the viola genus. It is used in traditional medicine for its purported health benefits, which include treating digestive issues, reducing inflammation, and alleviating anxiety and stress. The therapeutic actions of Viola alba var. besseri are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including alkaloids, flavonoids, and glycosides, which exhibit anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and sedative properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand the effects of this plant on human health.
